content.text:
**Finding: deviation (§ 2.1, p0012)**

§ 2.1 binds us to a three-year, USD 2m-per-year take-or-pay commitment "without reduction or termination rights" — the rule's walk-away scenario, and short of even the fallback (12-month commitment, reducible on 30 days' notice, true-up not penalty). It also contradicts § 9.4 (our 30-day convenience termination with prepaid-fee refund), § 7.1 (Fees per Order Form; no minimum-use charges) and § 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges no minimum-volume commitment).

Redline (validated, preferred position): replace the commitment with confirmation that we have no minimum purchase/take-or-pay obligation and owe Fees only for Services ordered or actually used, with the 12-month reducible/true-up structure offered as fallback in the comment.
